description.value: Pan-Asia Market & Deli is a small Asian-focused convenience store and deli located in Chilliwack, BC. It combines everyday convenience store staples with Asian grocery products and deli offerings, making it a distinctive neighbourhood resupply option. Cyclists passing through Chilliwack would find it a useful stop for snacks, prepared foods, and specialty ingredients.
